selection: First track of each next six unseen singers in numeric ID order, metadata only; no audio, annotations or model output inspected.
averaging: equal-weight macro across six excerpts, separately per condition
scope: Six named singer-disjoint Vocadito excerpts (15,18,19,20,21,22), first10s solo and constructed0/-6dB mixtures, with two backing windows20-30s and silence. No population, commercial-mix, choir, singer-identity, calibrated-probability or training-independence claim.
purpose: One prospective singer-disjoint qualification of the v6 hybrid after adaptive development on all previously consumed groups.
stop_rule: Evaluate once; no threshold changes or replacement holdout after outcomes.
acceptance_rule: C=original v2 framewise acceptance AND available local q>=threshold. Fill only bounded internal zero-runs of ORIGINAL C whose length <=floor(max_internal_gap_s/effective_hop_s), into a temporary support envelope. Require all envelope rows within ceil(voicing_guard_s/effective_hop_s) each side. Final acceptance=C AND that erosion. Never bridge unavailable local evidence or invalid/out-of-duration rows; never fill a missing output or recursively update C.

local_statistic.name: candidate_period_local_agreement
local_statistic.sampling: numpy linear interpolation at midpoint +/- lag/2; require every position within available waveform samples and real input duration; no zero padding or clamped observations
local_statistic.centering: Subtract each arm mean separately in float64
local_statistic.statistic: A=mean(a*a), B=mean(b*b), C=mean(a*b); q=clip(2*C/max(A+B,2*min_source_rms**2),-1,1), all accumulated float64; undefined support gives NaN with local_supported=0. Silence/constant full-support arms give0.
local_statistic.interpretation: Local repeated waveform energy at candidate period, not voice identity or calibrated probability; periodic instrumental leakage and reverb can pass.
local_statistic.reference_scope: Symmetric normalization inspired by NSDF; this candidate-conditioned, mean-centered, amplitude-regularized veto is not the MPM pitch estimator.
